'''Jaim Thane''' is a boy from [[Emond's Field]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jaim Thane}}

== Activities ==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] returns to Emond's Field after a battle with [[Trolloc]]s, Jaim is one of the boys that runs to tell Loial he has returned.{{ref/book|4|43}}
